summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) announcing daily repurchases of its own ordinary shares under two existing buyback programmes announced 30 January 2026 and 31 July 2026, executed through broker Goldman Sachs International. Purchases for 21–25 September 2026 ranged from 106.70p to 111.00p per share, with volume-weighted averages near 107–110p and a zero-purchase day on 25 September. No aggregate programme size, premium, or close date was stated; shares will be cancelled, reducing share count. Watch execution pace versus programme authorization and any acceleration or suspension signals.
